dedupe_keys.name: baisa panama commodity exchange tariff quota auction results and operational summaries 1999 2025

description: BAISA is Panama's national commodity exchange, which runs the auctions for import tariff quotas of food products under trade agreements. Pages read on 2026-09-29 show yearly operational summaries from 1999 to 2025 and a 2025 table of volumes and amounts traded by product: pork 1,514,574 lb for B/.2,655,448, rice 209,904 quintals, dairy products 6,043 t for B/.24,737,796, potatoes, tomato derivatives and green coffee 90,000 quintals, B/.59,195,290 in total. The site also posts the call and results report of each 2026 auction round (for example pork, dairy and paddy rice under WTO quotas), annual summaries by negotiation type, and a price page linking the agricultural marketing institute's daily price system and the San Felipe Neri market. Coverage: national, Panama, food imports and domestic purchases handled on the exchange. Format and access: free web tables and PDF auction reports on baisa.com. Licence: not stated. Caveats: volumes cover only exchange-traded contracts, not total national supply; units differ by product. Simulation uses: food supply chain inputs for disruption and emergency supply studies. Related records: compare with Ecuador's agricultural market prices (data-sipa-ecuador-agricultural-market-prices) and the Athens central market statistics (data-okaa-athens-central-market-statistics).
